ac_text: [REVIEW] Driver names read clearly on an arc page
[REVIEW] Reviewer PASS/FAIL badges on proposed drivers still read green/red
guidance: Hue is met: the served badges use var(--wt-success)/var(--wt-danger), green/red in every palette, and dark mode does not override them. Two gaps. (1) The screenshot shows /arcs, which has no badges: capture arc-006 and arc-011 in light and dark mode to confirm visually. (2) White-text contrast is poor on the slate palette (:root default; PASS 2.5:1) and console (PASS 2.3:1, FAIL 2.8:1). The served stone palette gives PASS 4.1:1 and FAIL 5.8:1. Consider a darker badge background or dark text on the slate and console palettes.
